70010000096680.description:
A vibrant sci-fi platform adventure game for the Nintendo Switch™, where you help Maxwell the dog explore unfamiliar worlds, make strange new friends and contend with mysterious forces - by jumping, shooting, slicing, shrinking, warping and drilling.

Maxwell’s homeworld is nearing collapse. In a last ditch-effort to find help, he hyperjumps where no dog has gone before. Stranded, he finds himself on the edge of a hostile system - if there’s any hope of return and rescue he’ll need every friend (and every weapon) he can find.

Forced to confront this celestial expanse head on, Maxwell stays strong - determined to keep his head up and lend a helping hand to everyone he meets on his journey. Like all underdogs, the odds are stacked against him, but you can’t keep a good dog down.

Key Features
· Explore jam-packed levels with multiple routes
· Make 50+ friends & collect their friendship cards
· Upgrade your blaster with special abilities
· Find hidden areas and take on a variety of boss battles
· Local couch co-op multiplayer mode
· Bonus prequel content: Chapter Zero
70010000096680.intro: Help Maxwell explore unfamiliar worlds, make strange new friends and contend with mysterious forces.
70010000096680.name: Goodboy Galaxy

70010000131668.description:
The cursed tower rises before you: a colossus whose walls pulse with neon light and echoes of ancient battles. Deep within await the 5 Generals of the Demon King, surrounded by their infernal hordes. They have kidnapped the Saint to offer her as a sacrifice and open a portal that will allow their master to return to this world. Your mission is to plunge into the unknown and rescue her before the Dark Lord’s plans come to pass.

Control your flippers, keep the ball in play, and ascend a tower filled with enemies, secrets, and increasingly intense challenges.

Each room presents a new challenge: destroy enemies, activate powers through cards, and manage your resources to survive. As you progress, you’ll master the physics, discover hidden mechanics and secret routes, and find the keys needed to reach the true ending. Only those who explore carefully, adapt their strategy, and perfect their technique will unravel the secrets of the tower. How far can you go?

- Two game modes: Arcade Mode for quick sessions, and Adventure Mode, where saved items allow for progression.
- Co-Op Mode: Play with the help of a friend. Using the target cursor, they can select cards, defeat enemies, destroy attacks, and collect upgrades.
- Enter 10 challenge stages featuring bosses that will test your precision and skill as you discover their weak points.
- Defeat enemies as you ascend the tower’s 5 floors and uncover all its mysteries.
- More than 15 Power Cards scattered throughout the tower, allowing you to build your own strategy.
- Earn points and climb the online leaderboard.
- Unlock collectible visual filters and customize the game’s appearance.
70010000131668.intro: In Pinballoid Crush, classic pinball evolves into an arcade experience with adventure and strategy elements.
70010000131668.name: Pinballoid Crush

70010000130598.description:
Tarot Tokens is a strategic tile game inspired by the Fools journey through the major arcana of the tarot. Placing Tarot Tokens crafts your journey from four key aspects of the major arcana of the tarot: family, morals, conflict, hope.

Win With Virtues
The aim of Tarot Tokens is to build your three virtues up and keep them nicely balanced by making wise, or seemingly foolish choices, along the way. Run out of any virtue and the journey ends. Reach the end by taking all the steps and reflect on your journey - learn to see pass the numbers and embrace your whole journey.

The Fool
Every game starts with The Fool already placed. Your choices between the Tarot Tokens steers your journey, with the help of the Fools Abilities every few turns. Your journey through the life challenges of placing tokens shape the Fools path that is always different, always yours.

Silence Is Golden
Tarot Tokens has no sound of any kind, no music, no effects, nothing. Enjoy the silence or bring your own noise, much like when using real tarot cards for a reading. Feedback is visual only and there are options to tone it down if you find it a bit much.

Not A Deck Builder
You play with all 22 tokens of the major arcana, every game. A randomly selected number of tokens are offered to you each turn, except The Fool who is used only once at the start of every game. All tokens interact with some other tokens on the board. Each token has its own unique effect with most generating virtues in addition to other token interactions. 

Follow Your Path
Play your favourite token as often as you want, if it is available that turn. Or play highly tactically to gain maximum virtue and be really efficient, although you might just be missing out. Every token is always unlocked and randomly chosen every turn - no token fixing or token reading goes on (even though it might feel that way if your journey feels off).

A Hex On You!
Tarot Tokens uses a hex grid in shameless violation of the four sided card format of the tarot. The essence of the tarot is faithfully preserved in a hex shape with on-demand help explaining virtues, adjacency information, and a brief description of the significance of that tarot token in the context of the Fools journey. Hex grids are still over rated though!
70010000130598.name: Tarot Tokens

70010000111795.description:
Grab the mic—or your smartphone—and get ready to shine! Let’s Sing 2027 transforms any occasion into a musical celebration with a brand-new playlist of chart-toppers and classics from around the world. Sing solo for high scores or team up with friends and family for unforgettable duets and group performances.  

Featuring songs with their original music videos, adjustable vocal guide settings, and easy-to-use smartphone and mic support, Let’s Sing 2027 makes singing accessible, fun, and endlessly replayable. Whether you’re hosting a party or chasing your best score, it’s your turn to take center stage!

This year, step into Soundtown in an all-new Party mode—a lively musical adventure where you’ll face off against DJ Hush and bring the beat back to the city. With improved visuals, fresh avatars, and customizable rewards, every performance feels like a moment in the spotlight.

Featuring 35 chart-topping songs there's something for everyone—from modern hits to timeless classics.
* Chappell Roan – The Subway
* Lady Gaga, Bruno Mars – Die With A Smile
* Alex Warren – Ordinary 
* Drake – God's Plan 
* Ariana Grande – we can't be friends (wait for your love)
* Sabrina Carpenter – Espresso 
* Ed Sheeran – Azizam 
... And many more!

This product is not sold on its own.
70010000111795.intro: Sing your heart out with your friends on your favorite songs in our 1 to 4 players karaoke game.
70010000111795.name: Let's Sing 2027

70010000126212.description:
Get your friends together for Prinny Party: Going Overboard! In this party game, you’ll traverse the board as you take down demons, earn experience, and buy new equipment—all to make sure you’re strong enough to beat Laharl, the Supreme Overboard!

Work together to defeat heroes from classic Disgaea games or fight each other for every item. Whatever you do, just don’t die all at once, or it’ll be game over—for everyone! This Prinny-perfect experience is an RPG and a party all in one.
70010000126212.intro: Where there's a Prinny, there's a party!
70010000126212.name: Prinny Party: Going Overboard!

70010000135059.description:
Meet Pikmin, small, plantlike creatures you can grow, pluck, guide, and send into battle with enemies multiple times their size! These loyal, curious helpers come in different types, including fire-resistant Red Pikmin, Ice Pikmin that can freeze bodies of water, and Glow Pikmin that can light the way forward at night. The fate of your Pikmin is yours to decide!

Create and customize your own pint-sized explorer and traverse a world that is teeming with life—and visually enhanced with high-resolution graphics for the Nintendo Switch™ 2 system! 

Partner with Oatchi, your dependable space dog, and give him voice commands

Oatchi (pronounced oat-chee), resident good boy and dependable partner, can help with things like smashing obstacles and carrying you and your Pikmin throughout your adventure. With the miniscule Pikmin and a capable canine in tow, no challenge is too big—and you can even give him voice commands via the Nintendo Switch 2 system microphone as you play! 

Test your skill at Dandori Academy, and go explorer vs. explorer in Dandori Battles

Dandori is the art of commanding your Pikmin effectively, and in the world of the Pikmin™ 4 game, explorers like to get in on some friendly competition. Throughout the story you’ll encounter characters itching to compete in Dandori Battles, where you’ll need to gather plenty of Pikmin fast to collect the most objects within the time limit. 

That’s where the Dandori Academy comes in. Pikmin™ 4 – Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition + Dandori Academy adds a series of Dandori exams for you to train your skills on. And when you’re ready to take on your fellow explorers in Dandori Battles, you can even do so with a friend on the same system*—or via GameShare** locally or online via GameChat, even if they don’t have the game!

Already have Pikmin™ 4 for Nintendo Switch? Purchase the upgrade pack! 
    
If you already have the game for the Nintendo Switch system, you can purchase the upgrade pack*** separately to enjoy all the performance enhancements and additions of the Nintendo Switch 2 Edition, including Dandori Academy.

Explore more Creature Activity Level options and discover Decor Pikmin!

New to Pikmin? Try the Relaxed Creature Activity Level, where enemies take more damage and will never attack you first. If you’re a veteran player looking for true test, take on Fierce Creature Activity Level to face down tougher enemies with fewer Pikmin.

Keep your eyes peeled for Decor Pikmin wearing special outfits, and use the Field Camera to take photos of them. Not only will you add these special Pikmin to your squad, but you can also edit your photos with stamps, filters, and more for maximum style!
70010000135059.intro: Guide plantlike Pikmin on an enhanced expedition for Nintendo Switch™ 2!
70010000135059.name: Pikmin™ 4 – Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition + Dandori Academy

70050000081248.description:
Enhance your expedition with this upgrade pack*. The Pikmin™ 4 – Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition + Dandori Academy game features an extensive series of Dandori exam stages for you to test your skill and earn in-game medals! A total of 72 stages will be released over time—and they vary in difficulty, so you can choose the ones that match your skill level.

If you have a Nintendo Switch Online membership, you can also compare your high scores with players from around the world**. 

Give Oatchi voice commands, share Dandori with GameShare, and more

Use your voice to instruct your dependable space dog Oatchi with the Nintendo Switch 2 system microphone! You can also challenge your friends in Dandori Battles even if they don’t have the game via GameShare*** locally or online via GameChat.

This Nintendo Switch 2 Edition additionally features enhanced visuals!
70050000081248.intro: Upgrade your expedition with additional content on Nintendo Switch™ 2
70050000081248.name: Pikmin™ 4 – Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition + Dandori Academy Upgrade Pack

70010000100154.description:
What is Marupoyo: The Round Chick's Adventure?
A single-player, tilt-based platformer game for everyone. A heartwarming physics-based adventure for all ages. Players control Marupoyo’s momentum as he rolls through 120 vibrant levels, avoiding obstacles, exploring, and rescuing his lost siblings.

Why do we need Marupoyo: The Round Chick's Adventure?
Marupoyo is a charismatic, simple alternative to complex heroes, featuring a clean art style perfect for all ages. It offers the ideal mix of relaxing vibes and fun challenges. It's a unique game for everyone to enjoy alone or with the family.

What kind of players can enjoy the game?
The game is designed for everyone, having an easy  accessibility in the controls (just need to tilt the controller to play!) and with only one action: brake. Also, the Family Mode adds elements to avoid players dying, allowing players that like cozy games to play and have fun. However, the gamer mode brings more speed, deathly elements and adds lots of challenges to the game, such as beating the clock, getting the badge for not losing lives or the Pro player badge for not using brakes.

Story Summary
Marupoyo is a unique chick born so round he can’t walk — he can only roll! Though initially mocked for his clumsiness, he becomes the village’s only hope when a massive tornado scatters his family across the kingdom.

Guided by the Queen of Nature, Marupoyo rolls through forests, icy mountains, sandy deserts and volcanoes to stop an exiled Alchemist whose experiments are destroying the world. Along the way, he rescues his siblings and proves that his unique way of moving is actually a superpower - always rolling forward! Without fear, he will restore peace and become the kingdom's greatest hero.

Gameplay Elements
★ Physics Movements: tilt the board to move game elements.
★ Walls and floors: Colliding, Movable, walk-through and Bumpy.
★ Adversaries: Path Followers that may bump or defeat you.
★ Dangers: Cliffs, Holes, Water, Lava and Corruption will be hazardous.
★ Natural Hurdles: such as Water streams, Ice, Grass and Bumpy Mushrooms.
★ Family Mode: Cotton Clouds will cover most of the dangers in the levels.
★ Gamer Mode: Normal gameplay with all the challenges available.

Collectables and Challenges
★ Rescue all the family members during your trip. Once saved, you can visit them in your hometown and improve bonds with corn.
★ Win against the clock in Time Attack challenges in every level and earn extra Corn prizes (and a badge to be proud of!)
★ Collect all the Corn within a level and win an extra Corn prize (and again, medals for you!)
★ Find all the music tracks hidden in the game.

Family game mode
★ This mode is a bit slower, takes deathly stuff and adds clouds to avoid falling, reducing frustration.
★ Clouds will be bouncy, to keep it fun.
★ This mode eliminates the visual fear of younger players. (I don’t want to fall into lava)

Accessibility
★ Motion Sick toggle, to quit floor movement on screen and reduce dizziness. 
★ Sound volume split with Music, VO and Sound Effects.
70010000100154.intro: A tilt-based platformer game for everyone. Players control Marupoyo’s momentum as he rolls through 120 vibrant levels, avoiding obstacles, exploring, and rescuing his lost siblings.
70010000100154.name: Marupoyo: The Round Chick's Adventure

70010000092408.description:
*This is the Nintendo Switch™ version. There is also a Nintendo Switch™ 2 version of this game. Please select the version you require carefully. 

In this RPG, you befriend monsters from the DRAGON QUEST series, raise them up, synthesize new creatures, and pit them against other monsters in battle.

Join fledgling monster wranglers Bianca and Nera as they set off on the adventure of a lifetime.

[About the Game]
Befriend a Medley of Monsters
- There's a whole host of monsters to befriend, including many familiar favorites from across the DRAGON QUEST series.
- While each monster has its own traits and attributes, they can also learn a variety of talents, allowing you to fine tune your party to match your playstyle.
- Combine two monsters via synthesis to create an even stronger creature, maybe even one you've never seen before.
- Create a party of your favorite monsters that fights exactly the way you want. The possibilities are mind-boggling!

A World Full of Wonder
- With the game's unique visual style, you never quite know what lies beyond the curve of the horizon.
- Each step forward reveals more about your surroundings, where new discoveries and fresh surprises await.

Monsters by Your Side
- Your monsters will follow you as you explore the world so you can enjoy every adventure together.
- You can take any monster along with you, regardless of its type or size.

Stay Competitive with Extra Content
- Online features allow you to battle with monster wranglers the world over.
- With a variety of modes to enjoy, from serious tournaments to friendly matches, there's plenty to try.
- Send your strongest party into battle and be in with a shot at earning fantastic prizes!
70010000092408.name: DRAGON QUEST MONSTERS: The Withered World

70010000098133.description:
Leap into a lost world of mechanical wonders and embark on a hopping adventure with the adorable Labi! Use a wide range of jumps and moves to traverse this colorful cartoon world, meet squishy creatures and clumsy robots, and uncover its hidden secrets.

GAMEPLAY

Labi is all about powerful, precise jumps!

Installing a thruster module instead of a mobility module by mistake gave Labi the shortest yet most powerful legs of any robot. With those mighty legs, Labi can perform a Leg Launch and blast off like a cannonball, Stomp enemies with tremendous force, or spring off walls.

And it gets even better! Once Labi finds the Warp Ball, you can instantly teleport to wherever it lands. To overcome obstacles and solve puzzles, plan your route carefully and combine Running, Stomping, Dashing, and Double Jumping to find the best way forward. When danger strikes, Dash like a ninja and rely on your quick reflexes to dodge whatever comes your way.

GOALS

The core directive of Labi’s program: seek FREEDOM!

Collect Batteries scattered throughout each level. Some lie in plain sight along the main path, while others require a little extra exploration. At the end of each level, you will receive Gems based on the number of Batteries you collected. Gather enough Gems to unlock new areas.

Collect every Battery in a level to unlock its Time Trial. Complete the challenge to earn the level’s final Gem—a worthy prize for serious challengers!

FEATURES

Every being, organic or synthetic, has value—even robots. Cute ones, at least!

An enemy one moment may become your friend the next. Despite their intimidating appearance, enemies do not mind Labi bouncing on their heads. Manipulate, provoke, or even protect them, then use their abilities to complete levels in ways you never imagined.

STORY

An imaginary yet strangely realistic post-apocalyptic world.

Where did all these robots come from? Who created them? And why do those seemingly pointless assembly lines continue running forever?

Explore a fantastical world of giant fruit and adorable robots while uncovering a heartfelt story about humanity and identity. Journey through colorful, vibrant environments, interact with an intriguing cast of characters, and gradually piece together the history of this world. Help our little hero discover what truly matters, reveal everything that has been lost, and befriend a whole cast of totally huggable characters!
70010000098133.intro: Leap, warp, and uncover the secrets of a lost mechanical world with the adorable Labi!
70010000098133.name: Fall Up

70010000122696.description:
Join Noah and Mio, members of the two opposing nations of Keves and Agnus, on a heartfelt journey through a warring world with a dark secret. Traverse massive, fantastical landscapes and master seamless real-time RPG combat that has all been enhanced to run at 4K* resolution in TV mode, and full HD in handheld mode, at 60 frames per second with smoother and sharper cutscenes. 

The Nintendo Switch 2 Edition also features some additional content, including newly voiced event scenes!

Command six characters—including a mythical new Hero—and seamlessly enter real-time RPG combat

All six of your core party members jump into action against enemies, auto-attacking with their distinct arts and weapons. Position your team to take advantage of Arts and maximize damage and debuffs. Pairs of characters can Interlink to form a mighty Ouroboros capable of taking down the most threatening enemies with powerful Arts. 

The Nintendo Switch 2 Edition also adds the mythical new Hero, Shimmer to join you on your adventure! Shimmer is a speedy Attacker who can unleash devastating rapid-fire combos on her foes. She also wields the power of Foresight to see the future!

Test your strength against waves of enemies in Heroes’ Vault mode

Defeat as many enemies as you can in a defensive battle mode, exclusive to the Nintendo Switch 2 Edition. The more enemies you defeat, the more you’ll fill a gauge that you can use to strengthen your forces. Enhance your abilities, gain additional allies, but choose wisely—you’ll need to prepare well to defeat the almighty foe awaiting you at the end!

Already have Xenoblade Chronicles™ 3 for Nintendo Switch? Purchase the upgrade pack! 
    
If you already have the game for Nintendo Switch, you can purchase the upgrade pack** separately to enjoy all the performance enhancements and additions of the Nintendo Switch 2 Edition, including the additional Hero and Heroes’ Vault mode.
70010000122696.intro: Live to fight. Fight to live. Now with enhancements for the Nintendo Switch™ 2 system
70010000122696.name: Xenoblade Chronicles™ 3 – Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition

If you need a monster that only shows itself at a certain location at a specific time, or is otherwise only obtainable through synthesis, you can use the Mega Mole Hole to make an easier time of befriending it.

Downloadable content for DRAGON QUEST MONSTERS: The Withered World.

In Monster Marathons, you send out a party on an expedition mini game, instructing your monsters when to run and jump as you guide them to their destination. The farther your monsters travel, the more experience points and gold coins they'll earn, and the more crafting items they'll be able to pick up.

Along the way, your party will run into enemy monsters. The only way to avoid them, and go as far as you can, is with perfectly timed jumps and expertly controlled speed.

- This content does not include the main game of DRAGON QUEST MONSTERS: The Withered World.

70050000071756.description:
Downloadable content for DRAGON QUEST MONSTERS: The Withered World.

The metallic ring is a special item you can use while out exploring to turn all the enemies in the area into metal monsters* or hunter mechs. You can use the metallic ring as many times as you like, but you'll have to wait 30 in-game minutes between uses.

The effects of the metallic ring wear off after some time has passed or if you leave your current area.

Depending on when you use the metallic ring, you may encounter monsters that provide far more experience points than otherwise available at that stage in the story. So whether you're just starting out or have already completed the main story, you can use the metallic ring to quickly and effectively boost your monsters' experience points.

*The metal monsters are metal slimes, liquid metal slimes and metal king slimes.

- This content does not include the main game of DRAGON QUEST MONSTERS: The Withered World.
- This content and other bonuses are available as part of the DIGITAL DELUXE EDITION and the DLC 4-ITEM SET. Please bear this in mind to avoid making duplicate purchases.

- The content will be available to use only after the second main area of story has been completed.
70050000071756.name: Metallic Ring

While the Scout Run is available in the base game, this item provides a range of extra benefits, including a bigger allowance of scouty snacks, more monsters appearing at one time, and a reduced wait time between uses.

*With the Scout Run feature, you use special items called "scouty snacks" to befriend monsters without having to enter battle. You can use this feature as many times as you like, but you have to wait a short while between uses.

70010000080760.description:
***The aroma of bread in memories... In this moment, let's start anew!***

This is a world where bread is gradually being forgotten.

Until one day, in the corner of the world, an accidental explosion triggered by the main character Chaya, who was forced to stay in a rundown town where she is unfamiliar with the little store owner Effie to rebulid her bakery.

And the good smell from the insignificant oven is - the almost lost delicious food, **BREAD**!

## Collect materials in areas with your style!

Use your weapon and skills to create a path!

There're multiple weapons to choose from,

They all have a unique skilltree to make your own playstyle!

* Multiple areas with different theme and challenges!
* The locals are cute but also dangerous!

## Delicious bread for the bakery!

Sell breads in your own bakery!

* Set up the rack of breads for most outcome!
* Customers are in need! Help them or lose the opportunity!
* Make sure there're breads to sell!
* Clean up that floor, or you might lose some money!

## Develop deserted town, meet new friends!

With power of bread, new possibilities are opened!

* New friends will join the town with your progress!
* Research and upgrade the recipes to become top rated shop!
* Make deserted town great by developing new buldings!
70010000080760.intro: A bread revolution across the world now begins!

70010000114002.description:
*This is the Nintendo Switch™ version. There is also a Nintendo Switch™ 2 version of this game. Please select the version you require carefully. 

Romancing SaGa 3, the acclaimed JRPG first released in Japan in 1995, returns in a full 3D remake. Whether you're a longtime SaGa fan or a newcomer, this reimagining offers a fresh take on a classic adventure.

■Story
Every 300 years, Morastrum, the Star of Death, rises, dooming all born beneath it except the mysterious Child of Destiny. Nearly twenty years after its last appearance, an insurrection in Loanne uncovers a far greater threat: the Four Sinistrals seek to reopen the gates to the Abyss. Eight heroes bound by fate must unite to save the world.

■Characters
Choose from eight protagonists, each with a unique story, and recruit over twenty allies to your party

■Graphics
Inspired by the original pixel art and Tomomi Kobayashi's illustrations, the remake features character designs by Yoshiro Ambe and fully realized 3D environments.

■Freeform Scenario System
Your choices shape the adventure, from the stories you pursue to the order in which you challenge the Sinistrals, creating a unique experience every playthrough.

■Battle and Character Power Systems
Classic SaGa features such as Glimmer and Formation return alongside a new timeline-based battle system and United Attacks for deeper tactical combat.

■Difficulty
Choose from Casual, Normal, or Classic difficulty to tailor the challenge to your playstyle.

■Music and Voices
Original composer Kenji Ito supervised newly arranged music, with players able to switch between original and arranged tracks.
70010000114002.intro: A remake of Romancing SaGa 3! Choose from eight heroes in this turn-based RPG.
70010000114002.name: Romancing SaGa 3: Destinies United

70010000120381.description:
Your final year at Duel Academy is officially underway!  Select your partner from over 100 visually upgraded characters and conquer your opponents as a Dueling duo! Strengthen your affinity with your classmates and build memories as you study the art of Tag Dueling and prepare for a Graduation Duel to remember! 

Get Your Game On! Classic Dueling is back and rebuilt with over 3,800 cards, including additional fan-favorite cards beyond those featured in the original Yu-Gi-Oh! GX TAG FORCE 3. Build your Deck, develop unique strategies, and enjoy student life at Duel Academy as you Duel your way to victory.

Yu-Gi-Oh! TAG FORCE GX marks the first-ever Americas debut of Yu-Gi-Oh! GX TAG FORCE 3 content, which was previously unreleased in North and Latin America.

《New Features》
・Unleash your inner HERO! Over 3,800 cards, including additional cards supporting GX-era Decks. 
・Class is in Session Explore, investigate and expand your extracurricular activities with new and renewed mini-games. 
・Duel the World Enter a Casual Duel or Room Match to enjoy both Tag and 1v1 Duels with Online Multiplayer!
・Gallery Mode Reminisce with story scenes from Yu-Gi-Oh! GX TAG FORCE and Yu-Gi-Oh! GX TAG FORCE2.

[About "Yu-Gi-Oh!"]
"Yu-Gi-Oh!" is a popular manga created by Kazuki Takahashi that was serialized in SHUEISHA Inc.'s "WEEKLY SHONEN JUMP" since 1996. Konami Digital Entertainment Co., Ltd. provides a Trading Card Game (TCG) and console games, based on "Yu-Gi-Oh!" created from the original manga, that has been enjoyed around the world.
70010000120381.intro: Duel Alongside Your Partner and Forge Your Own Future!
70010000120381.name: Yu-Gi-Oh! TAG FORCE GX

70010000117150.description:
An Unlikely Alliance

Adventures are better together… even when they don’t start that way.

In a distant corner of the Kingdom, two enterprising young souls, Moira and Adrius, find themselves in over their heads when a heist goes wrong, accidentally binding their fate to that of the realm’s greatest heroes.

Now together with Amadeus, Zoya, and Pontius, the unlikely party must journey across perilous fantasy landscapes and overcome mounting challenges to restore a powerful magic gone awry before a dangerous warlock closes in to reclaim what is his.

Perplexing Puzzles

Trine 6’s puzzles are designed with a co-op-first approach, encouraging players to work together, coordinate actions, and combine abilities to progress. All puzzles can be solved by any character, giving players the freedom to choose their characters based on preferred playstyle rather than hardcoded puzzle requirements.
For those who prefer to go it alone, updated puzzle designs also allow solo players to take on the challenges themselves.

Shared Adventure

Play with up to four players and share every moment of the adventure together. Work through challenges, celebrate shared victories, and laugh through the occasional bit of chaos with friends on the same couch or across the world via crossplay.

Take Your Time

All characters can make use of the brand-new Time-Slow ability for a bit of extra control when it matters most. Slow down the world around you to help line up precise jumps, react to threats, dodge incoming attacks, or just provide some breathing room in the most chaotic moments.

Dynamic Combat

Dodge incoming strikes, find openings, and focus your attacks while adapting to enemies with distinct abilities, including those that shield or strengthen their allies. Combat and movement go hand in hand, requiring positioning, timing, and coordination to succeed.
Boss encounters push these skills even further, blending combat, traversal, and environmental challenges into memorable trials."
Discover Secrets

Venture through a vibrant, handcrafted fantasy world filled with hidden paths and secrets waiting to be uncovered. Explore each level carefully to find rewards to help power up your heroes.

Five Unique Heroes

Trine 6 features five playable characters: three returning favorites and two brand new to the series. Each character offers a distinct playstyle and unlockable skills:
•	Amadeus the Wizard: Summon objects and manipulate the world with magic.
•	Zoya the Thief: Fire arrows at foes and use a rope to traverse and interact with the environment.
•	Pontius the Knight: Crush enemies with a hammer and use his shield to defend and propel allies.
•	Moira the Acrobat: Chain together fluid kick combos and swing through the world using her ribbon.
•	Adrius the Squire: Wield a spear in combat or plant it to create platforms for traversal.
70010000117150.intro: Trine 6: Together in Time is a co-op puzzle platformer for 1–4 players. Wit, timing, and teamwork collide in the next adventure through this fantasy world.
70010000117150.name: Trine 6: Together in Time
